provenance.source_title: Your Life as Every Colombian Cartel Rank

examples.psychological_goal: 用绰号解构开场：名字有，实物没有
examples.expression_mechanism: 绰号卸妆（叫铃铛手，但没有铃）
examples.example_text: Level one, campanero. That's what they call you, but there's no bell, just you, a corner, and a phone
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他们叫你X，但没有X，只有A、B和C」把浪漫绰号还原成赤裸处境
examples.negative_instruction: 还原的三件物必须具体到可拍（你/街角/手机），不可抽象

examples.psychological_goal: 用家庭收入换算给童工定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 周/月换算（你一周=母亲一月）
examples.example_text: You're 12 years old making more in a week than your mother makes in a month cleaning houses.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你X时间挣的=Y时间挣的」+年龄，一句话写出诱惑的全部重量
examples.negative_instruction: 对照方必须是具体亲人的具体工作，不可用平均工资

examples.psychological_goal: 用秒数给底层岗位下规格
examples.expression_mechanism: 秒级职责（30秒预警=全部价值）
examples.example_text: Your job is to give them 30-second warning if trouble comes. 30 seconds to scatter through back doors you're not supposed to know about.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你的活是给X秒」把大组织的底层岗位压成一个数字
examples.negative_instruction: 数字必须小且精确（30秒），不可写「尽快」

examples.psychological_goal: 点破「被无视」的战术价值
examples.expression_mechanism: 无视即护甲（只是另一个孩子）
examples.example_text: The soldiers barely glance at you, just another kid. That's why they picked you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他们几乎不看你——这正是他们选你的原因」把弱点翻成资产
examples.negative_instruction: 两句必须构成因果（无视→被选中），不可只写自嘲

examples.psychological_goal: 用点头与不再回去写价值观的翻转
examples.expression_mechanism: 劝诫反收（他错了，这值得）
examples.example_text: He told you to stop, told you it's not worth it. You nodded and haven't been back since because he's wrong. It is worth it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让人物表面接受劝诫、用行动否决，再用一句短判定性
examples.negative_instruction: 判词必须冷酷短促（It is worth it.），不可给心理铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 用感觉消失计量异化进度
examples.expression_mechanism: 麻木刻度（第一次难→第三次无感=擅长）
examples.example_text: The second was easier. By the third, you didn't feel anything. That's when you knew you were good at this.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第N次的感觉变化」把异化写成可计量的进度条
examples.negative_instruction: 「擅长」必须反讽（good at this），不可写成赞美

examples.psychological_goal: 用心跳的缺席写杀手的职业化
examples.expression_mechanism: 生理缺席（心跳不再加速）
examples.example_text: You're gone before he hits the ground. Your heart doesn't even race anymore.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个本该出现的生理反应的消失，证明人已变
examples.negative_instruction: 生理反应必须具体（heart race），不可写「不再害怕」

examples.psychological_goal: 用不信也不问写家人的共谋式沉默
examples.expression_mechanism: 不信不问（她不信，但她不问）
examples.example_text: You told her you got a construction job. She doesn't believe you, but she doesn't ask.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「她不信，但她不问」写家人在真相前的自我保护
examples.negative_instruction: 谎必须具体（construction job），不可写「瞒着她」

examples.psychological_goal: 用配比公式给治理下定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 配比公式（恐惧+仁慈，过狠则反，过软则弱）
examples.example_text: Balance fear and mercy. Push too hard, people rebel. Too soft, they think you're weak.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「配比A和B：太A则X，太B则Y」给权力技术定型
examples.negative_instruction: 两端后果必须对称（rebel/weak），不可只写一端

examples.psychological_goal: 用给与守的区分给地盘下定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 给与守（地盘不是给的，是守的）
examples.example_text: Time to remind people how this works because territory isn't given, it's held.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X不是被给予的，是被Y的」给资产的本质下定义
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须是持续动作（held），不可是静态词

examples.psychological_goal: 用点头的双义写权力场的危险
examples.expression_mechanism: 褒奖即警告（有价值=知道太多）
examples.example_text: That nod means you're valuable, indispensable. It also means you know too much.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「这意味着A，也意味着B」让一次表扬同时是死刑预告
examples.negative_instruction: B必须由A推出（不可替代→知道太多），不可拼接

examples.psychological_goal: 用逃生包清单写「准备好却不走」
examples.expression_mechanism: 逃生包清单（账户/护照/退出计划）
examples.example_text: You've got money hidden in accounts they don't know about, passports under names they've never heard, an exit plan.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三个名词短语并列展示「全都备好了」，为「但你不走」蓄力
examples.negative_instruction: 清单必须是名词短语（无动词），读起来像核对单

examples.psychological_goal: 用不指控展示高层权力语言
examples.expression_mechanism: 不指控只说明（有人失败了，失败有后果）
examples.example_text: You don't accuse anyone. You just explain. Someone failed. Failure has consequences.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不指控，只说明+抽象宣判」写不需要名字的处决
examples.negative_instruction: 宣判必须无主语（Someone failed.），名字留给后果

examples.psychological_goal: 用高度的双关写权力的悖论
examples.expression_mechanism: 高度悖论（摔下去必死，却不够高到安全）
examples.example_text: You've climbed so high that the fall would be fatal, but you haven't climbed high enough to be safe.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「高到X，却不够高到Y」写权力阶梯上没有平台
examples.negative_instruction: X/Y必须同一意象（fall/safe 都属高度），不可换词

examples.psychological_goal: 用换字公式给顶级处境定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 换字公式（权力换自由，这就是交易）
examples.example_text: The day you step outside, you're arrested or killed. Power for freedom. That's the trade.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「A for B. That is the trade.」把处境压成一句交易条款
examples.negative_instruction: 前句必须先给代价场景（踏出去的那天），公式才不空

examples.psychological_goal: 用比较级给隐身术定性
examples.example_text: Myths are harder to kill than men.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X比Y难杀」给「故意消失」的策略一句定性
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是抽象物（myths），Y必须是具体物（men）

examples.example_text: You've seen it happen to everyone before you. Pablo, Carlos, Miguel, all ended the same way.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你见过它发生在每个人身上+名字点名」写宿命不可避
examples.negative_instruction: 名字必须是前文观众已知的前任，不可新造

examples.psychological_goal: 用对方的微笑写洗钱的成功
examples.expression_mechanism: 对方反应佐证（银行见到你都微笑）
examples.example_text: You turn drug money into clean money and you do it so well the banks smile when they see you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你做得X到连Y都微笑」借对方的反应给能力背书
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须是本应警惕你的角色（银行），反应才构成讽刺

examples.expression_mechanism: until 终判（不可触碰，直到你不再是）
examples.example_text: You run everything. You control everyone. You're untouchable until you're not.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个全能短句+一句「X until you are not」完成宿命式收尾
examples.negative_instruction: until 后必须不自解释（不说哪天），悬置即是警告
